text:
jess: FYI — customer acme-sre hitting 400 on POST /v1/rerank. Payload attached.

jess: ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"request_id":"req-123","items":[{"id":"q1","query":"hotels"},{"id":"q2","query":"restaurants"}],"candidates":[[], null, [{"id":"c1","text":"Hotel A","score":0.7}]]}'
```

jess: API returns 400: `{"error":"Invalid request: candidates must be non-empty arrays for each item; found empty/null at indices [0,1]"}`

sam: Which SDK / client are they using? Node / python?

jess: Node 2.3.1 via our internal client. They say it worked before; started failing after a frontend refactor.

ingrid: Can you repro locally? Looks like candidates should be an array per item or a flat array depending on client. Share the exact spec we validate against.

jess: Minimal repro (from their debug): ```json
{"request_id":"req-123","items":[{"id":"q1","query":"hotels"}],"candidates":[[]]}
```

maria: (client engineer) — our batching code accidentally maps candidates to a nested array and sends empty arrays when a partition has no candidates. Fixing now. :face_with_monocle:

sam: Two action items: 1) support note to client (tell them to ensure candidates is an array of candidate objects for each item), 2) add clearer error that mentions JSON path and index. I'll log an infra ticket.

ingrid: Also confirm Content-Type header; we saw double-encoded JSON in another report (stringified JSON inside a string) causing candidates to be a string not array. Suggest validation that returns the field path in the 400 body.

jess: Repro steps for eng: 1) curl above 2) run node snippet attached 3) check proxy logs for body truncation or serialization issues.

jess: Node snippet: ```js
const payload = {request_id: 'req-123', items:[{id:'q1',query:'x'}], candidates:[[]]};
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', {method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization': 'Bearer $T','Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(payload)}).then(r=>r.text()).then(console.log);
```

rerank-bot: Ticket #INC-4123 created for validation-improvement (priority: P3).

jess: Client patched their batching; confirmed fixed on their end, 200 responses returned. Closing with note to add more descriptive 400 body.

sam: Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
